scope: T12 corpus metrics needs-fix remediation only
fixes: Manifest schema, docs, parser, fixtures, and tests now enforce the exact plan line 58 corpus ground-truth contract fields: corpus_id, source_artifact_id, source_sha256, expected_artifact_type, expected_path_pattern, expected_hash, expected_timestamp_range, expected_state, negative_controls, notes.

Committed lightweight non-client source and expected fixture files now exist under tests/fixtures/corpus, with source_sha256 and expected_hash values tied to real SHA-256 values rather than nonexistent paths.

Parser rejects missing required ground_truth fields through typed serde parsing and contract checks; tests parse JSON and remove required fields structurally instead of relying on substring assertions.

src/qa_accuracy.rs was split into focused src/qa_accuracy/ modules for typed manifest parsing, indexed evidence parsing, metric computation, contract checks, and report rendering; every qa_accuracy module is under 250 pure LOC.
Synthetic-only mixed_real_world_like still fails closed for release-key pass semantics and remains explicitly unsupported in the manifest.

verification.command: jq structural schema checks, fixture shasum checks, and git diff --check

happy_assertions: accuracy report includes precision, recall, false_positives, false_negatives, source_sha256, expected_hash, contract_keys, unsupported domains, and mixed_real_world_like unsupported status
reproducibility report includes allowed thresholds and zero normalized core differences for case-a versus case-b
failure_assertions: altered expected/source hash manifest exits nonzero with false_negatives=1 and hash_mismatch=1
missing source_artifact_id manifest exits nonzero with a typed missing-field parse error

adversarial_classes.malformed_input: pass: bad hash manifest exits 1 with false_negative/hash_mismatch; missing source_artifact_id exits 1 with parse failure. Evidence: t12-fix-manual-qa-failure.txt.
adversarial_classes.dirty_worktree: pass: final receipt records broad dirty state is pre-existing and T12 work isolated; no staged files. Evidence: t12-fix-final-worktree-state.txt.
adversarial_classes.stale_state: pass: manual QA generated fresh case reports under fixture report dirs and copied them to evidence; cleanup removed fixture reports afterward. Evidence: t12-fix-manual-qa-happy.txt and t12-fix-cleanup-receipt.txt.
adversarial_classes.misleading_success_output: pass: assertions use jq-parsed JSON metrics and command exit codes, not success prose. Evidence: t12-fix-manual-qa-happy.txt and t12-fix-manual-qa-failure.txt.
adversarial_classes.flaky_tests: pass: focused tests reran warning-free; full cargo test --locked passed. Evidence: t12-fix-focused-tests-final.txt and t12-fix-cargo-test-locked.txt.
adversarial_classes.hung_or_long_commands: pass: verification transcripts record bounded command durations and all commands completed. Evidence: t12-fix-* transcripts.
adversarial_classes.prompt_injection: not_applicable: manifests are parsed as typed JSON data and no manifest text is executed or interpreted as instructions.
adversarial_classes.cancel_resume: not_applicable: no resumable or cancellation handling flow added.
adversarial_classes.repeated_interruptions: not_applicable: no interrupt handling behavior changed.

cleanup.status: no staged files; no fixture reports/qa temp roots remain; no frametrace/cargo QA processes remain; no diffs under .omo/boulder.json, .omo/start-work/ledger.jsonl, or .omo/plans

risks: The validation corpus remains lightweight and non-client by design; large external corpora are represented by hash-only references with provenance.
Release-gate completion still requires root independent verification; no plan checkbox was edited or claimed.
